title: My Favourite Months
text:
My favourite month is October. It is cold and the leaves are yellow. On the thirty-first of October we have a party. Children wear costumes.

My sister's birthday is in March, on the eighth. In March it is spring. We often go to the park. We eat ice cream there.

questions.text: What is the narrator's favourite month?
Why do the children probably wear costumes on the thirty-first of October?
options: They are going to a party
They are going to the doctor
They are going to bed early

questions.text: What does the narrator probably like to do in spring?

vocabulary.definition: a social event where people eat, drink and celebrate
the season after winter, when plants start to grow
clothes that people wear to look like someone or something else

paragraph_translations: Мій улюблений місяць — жовтень. Зараз холодно, і листя жовте. Тридцять першого жовтня ми маємо свято. Діти носять костюми.
День народження моєї сестри — у березні, восьмого числа. У березні весна. Ми часто ходимо в парк. Там ми їмо морозиво.
